description: VBB-Fahrplandaten via GTFS is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Der Verkehrsverbund Berlin-Brandenburg (VBB) stellt zweimal wöchentlich (mittwochs und freitags) die aktuellen Bus- und Bahn-Fahrplandaten aus Berlin und Brandenburg im GTFS-Format zur Verfügung. Mehr zu dem Format ist unter (auf Englisch)) zu finden. Deutschlandweite Haltestellen (DHID) können im zentralen Haltestellenverzeichnis ( abgerufen werden. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are bahn, bus, fahrplan, fähre, s-bahn. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
